name: LumiAR
summary:
Explore reality in 4D.

LumiAR brings the 4DScanLab volumetric archive to Meta Quest. Every performance is captured on a 60-camera rig in our Saigon studio: real people, in motion, recorded as true 3D over time. It is not a flat video. It is a moment, kept whole.

Put on your headset and the performer stands on your floor, in your own room, through passthrough. Walk around her. Lean in. Look from behind. Every angle is real.
